lesson.title: Wonders of Steelmanning
lesson.topic: Explore how strengthening opposing viewpoints through steelmanning can enhance your understanding and appreciation for complex ideas and reality.
lesson.steelman: How does actively seeking out the strongest arguments against your beliefs help you to develop a more nuanced worldview?
lesson.example: A debate on the benefits of traditional education vs. homeschooling, where participants aim to argue the best case for both sides before synthesizing insights.

rationale: Encourages critical thinking and intellectual humility by integrating wonder with the practice of steelmanning.
